english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is almost, but not quite, the case.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gei1 fu4 gon2 m4 cit3 baan1 ce1

english.note: Use this before a negative expression when something is almost not happening at all, as in barely seeing something.

exampleSentences.english: I could barely see the word.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gei1 fu4 tai2 m4 dou2 go3 zi6

english.note: Use this especially for emphatic nearly-all, nearly-none, or nearly-but-not-quite statements.

exampleSentences.jyutping: gei1 fu4 mou5 jan4 gei3 dak1 ni1 gin6 si6
